title: 模仿者引擎上线后，升级植物（41/44/40 等）的老师行为或标签审计

method.labels: frames[i].label if present else frames[i].action; action_rejected rows excluded; packet slot -> kind from the previous frame's packets
method.segments: read-only scan of 4,913 immutable pack segments under frames/packs/segments
method.replay: EventWaitEnv with explicit --executable; same deck/seed/action prefix on both engines; full observation, legal_actions, compact _frame (including obs-v3 v3 token payload) compared recursively
method.constraints: nice -n 19 ionice -c3, ulimit -v 4000000, at most one replay process at a time, no pytest

post_1538.note: the post-switch L4 decks in this corpus contain no upgrade card at all

opportunity_vs_planted.definition: decision frames where the card is present and active and sun >= packet cost; ready_base additionally requires its base plant on the board (41->1, 44->39, 40->7)

step1_teacher_upgrade_behaviour.conclusion: Teacher upgrade behaviour did not fall after the engine switch. L9 never planted any upgrade card in either segment (0/119,764 pre, 0/30,140 post); L8's upgrade share rose slightly (0.143% -> 0.192%), with 41/44 appearing only in post-switch decks; kind 40 was never planted anywhere in production. L9's 41 was affordable with a sunflower base only 55 times pre and 0 times post, so zero plantings is expected rather than a regression.

forced_41.task: level 1, deck [1,41,0,2,3,4], seed 12345, base sunflower -> twin sunflower

forced_44.task: level 1, deck [39,44,0,2,3,4], seed 12345, base melon-pult -> winter melon

archive_replay.note: the harness re-synced by waiting and diverged from the archive tick at decision 69; both engines were compared at the same state and were identical, so this is a secondary check only. The forced tests above are the authoritative parity check.

step2_encoding_parity.conclusion: For non-Imitater upgrade cards 41 and 44, the two production engines produce bit-identical observations, legal action masks, compact frames and obs-v3 token payloads, and both accept the same plant action. The task225 change resolves the Imitater packet identity only; it does not change upgrade card identity or slot encoding.

checks.conclusion: Every upgrade plant row stores the card slot in `packet` and the upgrade plant type in `packet_col0`; 41 is 9/41, not 9/1, and 44 is 3/44, not 3/39. No upgrade label needs re-export or deletion.

root_cause.verdict: Not the upgrade plants and not task225 encoding. The L9 collapse is a training-trajectory instability caused by the corpus-growth sampler: the round adds new positive rows, the global `train_idx` length/order changes, and `torch.randperm(len(train_idx))` re-batches every old row in a different order. L9 and upgrade labels are not even active rows.

timeline_evidence.implication: No L9 data entered at r102, yet L9 B fell 12/12 -> 4/12. The first L9 imitater1 archives arrived only at r103, when L9 B fell to 0/12.

r102.detail: c102opening119l32magnet*_b0/b1 and c102opening119l37magnet*_b0/b1, checkpoint gptbc_s1 -> source_kind teacher_gptbc (weight 1.0)
r102.other_new_labels: 49 labels (L6/L7/L8 0.5x day, night, gpt193, opening scoreboard) have checkpoint round_000101/000095 -> source_kind teacher_line, weight 0.0 in the r101-r103 recipes

r103.detail: c103demoboss50*, c103demofog31/32*, c103demoroof47*, c103opening119l32/l37magnet*, c103rd193l39m050* -> teacher_gptbc (weight 1.0)

positive_rows_added.zero_weight_note: r102/r103 added 49+42 teacher_line labels; at r103 they account for 202,738 pack rows. They have weight 0 and cannot contribute gradients, but they still shift the pack row order.

sampler_mechanism.why: The permutation is over global positions, not stable row ids. Adding 16,615 positive rows at r102 changes both len(train_idx) and the row values under each position, so every epoch uses a different global batching of the old rows. A 0.09% corpus addition therefore produces a different model, including a different L9 policy.

l9_policy_drift.reading: The collapse is an economy/strategy drift towards puff-shroom+coffee-bean and away from chomper/pumpkin/peashooter, not a failure to plant 41. 41 is used 0-5 times per 12-23 games in every arm.

fix.primary: Make the training sampler invariant to corpus growth: shuffle with a stable per-row key (archive seed + source_row + training seed), or sort train_idx by a stable row id and permute per-archive, instead of torch.randperm(len(train_idx)). Then retrain from r101/gptbc_s1 with the r102/r103 corpus; no data deletion is required.
fix.data_side_ab: If a data-only workaround is wanted before the sampler fix: (1) minimal single-variable test: zero-weight or exclude the 4 r102 opening labels (48 archives, 16,615 rows) and retrain the r102 candidate from gptbc_s1; (2) if L9 still does not recover, also exclude the 11 r103 positive labels (39,593 rows), total 56,208 rows. Keep the zero-weight teacher_line labels; they cannot train and only need stable ordering.
fix.upgrade_labels: 0 rows. Do not re-export or delete 41/44/40 labels: slots and kinds are correct and both engines encode them bit-identically.
fix.gate_deck: Do not change the L9 gate deck or remove 41. 41 is never planted by the teacher in L9 and is not the cause; changing the deck would create a new task family under AGENTS.md 8.
fix.acceptance: A/B the fixed sampler against r101 on L9/L8/L4 with the same data and seed; L9 should return toward 12/12 without changing the card set.

zero_weight_teacher_line_rows.r102: 49 new labels; all weight 0 in the r101-r103 source_weight
zero_weight_teacher_line_rows.r103: 42 new labels, 202,738 pack rows; all weight 0

caveats: The forced 41/44 parity test uses level 1 to isolate encoding; level does not change the packet/plant encoding, and the pre-switch L8 archive replay at the 41 decision also produced zero diffs.
The archive replay harness re-synced ticks and diverged from the archive at decision 69; both engines were compared at the same state and matched, so it is supporting evidence, not the primary check.

This audit did not retrain. The sampler mechanism is proven by code and by the r102/r103 pack deltas matching the positive-row additions; whether the 16,615 r102 rows also contribute content-level gradient drift needs the proposed A/B.
Pack-row counts are reconstructed with the exact wait_keep=0.1 mask and match pack.log within 4 rows (16,615 vs 16,611; 39,593 vs 39,573).
Teacher upgrade statistics use the teacher label (`label` if present else `action`); DAgger rows are counted by the teacher label, as training does.
